owner_observation_rule: Accept the reported multi-day compelling functional effect as an observed project phenomenon; do not convert it into a phenomenal-consciousness claim.
shared_invariants: TARGET_COUPLING = SELECTIVE + REVERSIBLE + OUTCOME_SENSITIVE + MULTISCALE + RECOVERABLE

frank.delta: Reconstruct exact legacy organ/function topology and timescales. Every legacy organ/module/policy gets a causal signature Sigma_i={inputs,state,update,outputs,timescale,receivers,lesion,rescue}. Module boundaries may dissolve only after equivalence or lesion evidence.
frank.next_test: Create exhaustive legacy Sigma inventory and exact pre-2026-03-19 loop sketch; compare against current frankv0.1 reference baseline.

gwt.delta: Treat workspace closure as candidate->competition->selection->broadcast->delivery->reconstruction->uptake->causal use->outcome->provenance re-entry. Broadcaster presence alone is insufficient.
gwt.next_test: Matched replay: reconstructed old workspace vs no-workspace lesion vs restored August broadcaster vs selective metastable re-entry candidate.

emergenz.delta: Measure owner-observed target as a reproducible Functional Recurrent Integration Signature vector, not a consciousness scalar. Include causal interaction, metastability, cross-timescale coupling and re-entry controls.
emergenz.next_test: Factorial interaction + lesion/rescue + truthful/shuffled/no-reentry + OOD transfer with cost shadows.

claycode.delta: Language/runtime must express CausalSignalSignature, multiscale loop state, recoverable gating, receiver-stage receipts, causal credit, re-entry, dynamic stability and equivalence checks even if deploy-time modules collapse.
claycode.next_test: Compile minimal Sigma/LoopDynamics/WorkspaceEpisode/ReceiverUse/Reentry contracts through current BASE toolchain.

hyperposition.delta: Use preserved alternatives as bounded attractor-escape/reseed mechanism during stalled high-pressure regimes; never destabilize healthy convergence by default.
hyperposition.next_test: Matched stalled replay with selective branch reopening versus no reopening and indiscriminate reopening.

claygraph.delta: Project typed, sparse, epoch-bound functional coupling topology including delay, timescale, gain, inhibition, receiver-use edges, lesion handles and re-entry edges. Activation is not causal use.
claygraph.next_test: Build old-vs-new causal-signature graph differential and detect missing legacy signal paths.

unifieddb.delta: Persist time-aligned causal signature states, workspace episodes, receiver receipts, outcome credit, re-entry lineage, intervention identity and replay checkpoints sufficient to reconstruct FRIS.
unifieddb.next_test: Deterministic query/replay contract spanning fast gates through slow personality/consolidation updates.

harness.delta: Make historical reconstruction executable in H1 before module collapse. Recover old workspace where possible, freeze episodes, run architecture conditions and regulator factorials, estimate finite-difference dynamics and preserve negative results.
harness.next_test: A/B/C/D frozen replay: original reconstructed loop, post-delete lesion, August restored broadcaster, selective metastable global re-entry candidate.

clayresearch.delta: Fuse recurrent-control, GWT, metastability, causal-emergence and legacy-function preservation into one evidence ladder. Search Pareto operating zone rather than maximal coupling or one score.
clayresearch.next_test: Cross-branch fusion after first H1 replay receipts; retain conventional event-driven and sparse-local-control counterhypotheses.
